operational_safety_assumption.statement: Physical E-stop and mechanical limit proof-tests are explicitly excluded from this release; an on-site person remains responsible for safety while remote control is used.
operational_safety_assumption.effect: Operational prerequisite only; does not authorize actuator writes or change the fail-closed gate.

per_channel.required: authoritative circuit diagram plus proof-test result
hardware/controller safety function and de-energized-state observation
per-joint travel envelope plus restrained-fixture boundary test
mechanical-block contact/clearance inspection and boundary test
future customer-provided watchdog design and timeout-to-safe-state test

limitations: Topic/service names or user declarations alone cannot establish a safety function or authority.
No command, enable, stop, GPIO toggle, or physical motion was performed.
